rationale: local_preparer.py:1423 reads the authorization's evidence validity and checks it only as an int, authorized_at <= valid_until (:1432) or valid_until >= issued_at (:1437): no ceiling at the read. So the document instant is at most 120 s past the observation (producer-side ceiling, as in the membership lease rows; an externally signed larger value would be accepted unchecked, a consumer-side check would be a V03 decision).

rationale: RunContext.wait_until computes deadline = clock() + budget and polls until the predicate holds, Stop interrupts, or the clock reaches the deadline (owner_run.py:113-:125); it applies no ceiling or finiteness check to budget (the only reads of 'budget' in the file are :113, :115 and :116). A positive-infinity budget has no deadline, so v0.1.4 ships no ceiling on this wait (scans of 'wait_until' over every scoped file and of 'budget' in owner_run.py are pinned and re-derived).
